name: Student Finance Wales — Disabled Students' Allowance
description: The Student Finance Wales route for Disabled Students' Allowance support with extra higher-education study costs related to disability, long-term health conditions, mental-health conditions, autism or specific learning difficulties.
intended_use: Check the current Wales Disabled Students' Allowance rules, evidence and application guidance for the relevant academic year.
audience_or_context: Higher-education students from Wales using Student Finance Wales who have disability-related study-support needs.
limitations: Eligibility, evidence requirements, application arrangements and available support can change by academic year, so the current Student Finance Wales guide should be checked.
This resource records the Wales student-finance route and does not establish that an individual is eligible or what support will be approved.
University or college disability and accessibility support can exist alongside Disabled Students' Allowance.
cost_or_access_notes: Student Finance Wales guidance is publicly accessible. Disabled Students' Allowance is extra disability-related study support rather than a personal recommendation or individual entitlement decision.
conflicts_of_interest: Student Finance Wales provides student finance on behalf of the Welsh Government. ND Oracle records the official access route without making an eligibility or funding decision for any individual.

provenance.method: Student Finance Wales Disabled Students' Allowance guide for 2026 to 2027 checked on 2026-08-31. The resource records the official Wales access route without freezing annual maximum amounts or making an individual entitlement claim.
